title: Product Display Configurator with Undo/Redo
description: An interactive product showcase configurator where users arrange a WaterBottle and ToyCar on a rotating display platform. Users can drag items to different shelf positions, adjust individual scale and rotation, toggle spotlight colors per product, and cycle through backdrop themes — all while a conservation rule ensures total spotlight energy remains constant. Full undo/redo history tracks every change.
prompt: Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 (importmap from cdn.jsdelivr.net) that implements a product display configurator. Load WaterBottle.glb and ToyCar.glb using GLTFLoader. Scene setup: a circular platform (CylinderGeometry, metallic gray) with 4 marked shelf positions (glowing rings on the surface at 90-degree intervals). A gradient environment background that changes with theme selection. Camera: PerspectiveCamera at (0,3,6) looking at origin, with OrbitControls limited to 20-70 degree polar angle. Lighting: ambient light at 0.3 intensity, plus one SpotLight per product (initially white, intensity 2.0 each). Conservation law: total spotlight intensity across both products must always equal 4.0 — increasing one automatically decreases the other. Interactions (10-14 steps expected): 1) Raycaster-based click-and-drag to move each product between the 4 shelf positions (snap to nearest ring). 2) Mouse wheel while hovering a product scales it between 0.5x and 2.0x. 3) Right-click a product to cycle its spotlight color through white, warm amber, cool blue, magenta. 4) A bottom HUD with 3 backdrop theme buttons (Studio Dark, Nature Green, Sunset Orange) that animate the background gradient and platform material color over 0.5s. 5) A slider labeled 'Light Balance' that redistributes spotlight intensity between the two products while maintaining the conservation total of 4.0. 6) Undo/Redo buttons in the top-right corner that track every state change (position, scale, color, theme, light balance) in a history stack of up to 50 entries. Each shelf position should show a subtle pulse animation when a product is being dragged. Products cast shadows onto the platform. Add a slow auto-rotate toggle button for the entire platform. Display a small info panel showing current state: each product's position index, scale, spotlight color, and intensity.
